source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that any actual mutable configuration exposed on the Save & Exit page persists through its save/reboot path and returns to SPEC after Load Default, while distinguishing persistent fields from immediate actions such as save, discard, reset or launch-shell controls.
original_method: Inventory the page, select only a documented mutable field, set an approved non-default value, save/reboot and verify persistence; then load defaults, save/reboot and compare the same field with SPEC while confirming normal boot and management health.
manual_activity: An engineer must distinguish settings from immediate Save/Discard/Reset/Exit actions, operate the pre-OS menu, complete each approved transition and visually verify the resulting state. Agent health checks remain supporting evidence.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS identity and exact Save & Exit page inventory
Control type for every in-scope entry: mutable value versus immediate action
Approved mutable field, non-default and SPEC-default values
Expected confirmation, reset and boot behavior
safety_requirements: Do not apply all/random to immediate actions or invoke an unidentified save, discard, reset, shell or override control.
Do not claim persistence coverage when the selected entry is an action rather than stored state.
Capture the pending-change set before any save/discard action and verify which changes were committed.
Stop on unexpected reset, configuration loss, boot/OS failure or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware identity, boot, OS-log and BMC evidence around the operator actions.
Reconcile operator captures with the approved control-type and pending-change matrix.
Do not drive the page, invoke menu actions or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Inventory controls and select a real mutable field or explicitly redefine the case as an action test.
Perform and capture save/persistence/default operations and any confirmations.
Verify committed state and issue the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly refuses remote agent execution. No source command exists, and an OS health command cannot establish whether Save & Exit committed or discarded a particular pending firmware change.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the manual menu lifecycle; first classify each entry and use a known marker setting to prove commit/default behavior. Do not replace it with an OS reboot command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source save/reboot/default phases, null script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random is retained only as original text.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inventory page entries by action versus stored value, choose one harmless approved marker value, record the pending-change list, then prove exactly which transition commits it and how Load Default restores it.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact firmware Save & Exit implementation and confirmation behavior.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC revision and any console capture method version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Save & Exit menu documentation and SPEC defaults for the chosen marker field.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Avoids treating immediate actions as random settings and creates observable commit semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; clarifies the state transition the generic procedure intended to test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Page inventory, marker value, confirmation semantics and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms expose no persistent fields on this page; in that case the case must be scoped to named actions rather than inventing a setting.

project_override_considerations: If the platform has no mutable Save & Exit field, the project must explicitly select a named action and its expected pending-change result. That project interpretation must not rewrite the master source or claim generic setting persistence.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, page inventory/control types, approved marker and recovery
Save action/confirmation, reboot and marker persistence
Load Default/save action, reboot and SPEC comparison
Final configuration, boot/BMC health, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title is broad but does not explicitly contradict the persistence/default procedure. Page inventory determines whether a mutable field exists; absent detail is a readiness gap, not yet a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A coherent execution is available if the page has an approved mutable field. If not, a project-specific action scope is needed, but the present review can still define that decision gate without permanent BLOCKED status.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the manual conclusion and adds the essential distinction between stored controls and immediate actions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its bounded-field and recovery controls, corrects classification and strengthens commit-state evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents random invocation of Save & Exit actions and requires proof that a named pending change was committed and defaulted.

review_improvement: Makes the ambiguous page title executable through a control-type inventory and commit marker while refusing to invent a platform field.
independent_technical_reasoning: The page is pre-OS and its key semantics depend on human interpretation of action versus state plus visible confirmation. Automated post-boot health cannot perform that acceptance, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a Save, Discard, Reset, Exit or default action after an unexpected transition; preserve the pending-change and first-result evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
